chunks.title: AI 分销接口
chunks.content:
# AI 分销接口 (ai-distribution)
一次 MCP 集成，接完全部供应商
面向 AI Agent 时代的统一分销接口：标准 MCP 工具面覆盖搜索、实时报价与两段式确认预订；27+ 供应商连接器在同一个接口后面，报价自带证据信封，价格规则可配置。

## 核心价值
Agent 时代的新集成税是「每家供应商一个 MCP」。我们一次接入全部供应商，报价透明、规则可配、预订有确认边界。

## 技术亮点
- MCP streamable-http 托管端点 /mcp，多租户单端点，Bearer JWT 认证
- 三条接入路：hbcli mcp serve 本地网关 / 长空闲静态 key / OAuth 2.1 平台连接器
- 工具契约单一事实源：MCP 工具与 Agent Skill 同源渲染，防漂移
- 进程内直调分销内核：与现有 API/门户同一套服务与权限边界

chunks.title: AI Distribution Interface
chunks.content:
# AI Distribution Interface (ai-distribution)
One MCP integration. Every supplier.
The unified distribution interface for the AI-agent era: a standard MCP tool surface covering search, live rates, and two-phase confirmed booking. 27+ supplier connectors behind one interface, quotes that carry their own evidence envelope, and configurable pricing rules.

## Value proposition
The new integration tax of the agent era is one MCP per supplier. Integrate once for all of them — transparent quotes, configurable rules, and a hard confirmation boundary on bookings.

## Technical highlights
- Hosted /mcp endpoint over MCP streamable-http: multi-tenant, single endpoint, Bearer JWT auth
- Three onboarding paths: hbcli mcp serve local gateway / long-idle static key / OAuth 2.1 platform connectors
- One tool-contract source of truth: MCP tools and the Agent Skill render from the same contract with a drift guard
- In-process calls into the distribution core: same services and permission boundaries as the existing API and portal

chunks.title: AI 原生自动化
chunks.content:
# AI 原生自动化 (ai-automations)
在权限边界内调查业务数据
HotelByte 的 Data Agent 为已授权用户提供受治理的数据调查流程。可用数据源、脱敏效果和回答质量应使用真实权限与获批数据现场验证。

## 核心价值
让业务团队在已授权的数据范围内提出问题，并用原始结果验证回答。

## 技术亮点
- Data Agent 已注册的 MySQL 与 TDengine 读取工具
- 查询与输出的权限及脱敏检查
- 以来源和审计记录核查智能体回答

chunks.title: AI-Native Automations
chunks.content:
# AI-Native Automations (ai-automations)
Investigate business data within access boundaries
HotelByte Data Agent offers a governed investigation workflow for authorized users. Verify available data sources, masking and answer quality with real permissions and approved data.

## Value proposition
Let business teams ask questions within authorized data scope and verify answers against source results.

## Technical highlights
- Registered MySQL and TDengine read tools in Data Agent
- Access and response-masking checks
- Answer verification against sources and audit records

chunks.title: Lookout 价格情报
chunks.content:
# Lookout 价格情报 (price-intelligence)
洞悉市场，守护您的利润空间
Lookout 提供工业级的高并发价格情报抓取、时序存储与自动化比价服务，专为大规模 B2B 酒店分销设计。支持按计划运行比价与价格监控；报价竞争力须结合实际供应覆盖和市场价格评估。

## 核心价值
支持按计划运行比价与价格监控；报价竞争力须结合实际供应覆盖和市场价格评估。

## 技术亮点
- 基于 TDengine 的时序数据存储，支持按供应商、市场和日期分析历史报价
- 分布式爬虫集群，并发能力须按供应商配额与实际环境验证
- 智能速率限制学习与自适应退让算法
- 多维度价格异常检测与预警

chunks.title: Lookout Price Intelligence
chunks.content:
# Lookout Price Intelligence (price-intelligence)
Know the market. Protect your margins.
Industrial-grade high-concurrency price intelligence crawling, time-series storage, and automated benchmarking. Purpose-built for large-scale B2B hotel distribution.

## Value proposition
Schedule rate comparisons and monitor market changes; validate coverage and rate competitiveness against your own inventory.

## Technical highlights
- TDengine time-series storage: time-series analysis of supplier rate facts
- Distributed crawler cluster: throughput validated against supplier budgets and deployment conditions
- Intelligent rate-limit learning with adaptive backoff
- Multi-dimensional price anomaly detection and alerting

chunks.title: 企业级分销底座
chunks.content:
# 企业级分销底座 (b2b-distribution)
面向代理层级的分销架构
通过统一 API、供应商适配器与层级权限支持 B2B 分销。供应商可用性取决于凭证、配置与合作范围，适合用真实酒店和日期验证。

## 核心价值
统一 API 连接供应商适配器，层级实体和权限范围支持 B2B 代理业务；请用自身凭证验证覆盖。

## 技术亮点
- 平台、租户、客户和客户账号层级及权限范围
- 供应商适配器通过统一 API 处理上游差异
- 酒店与房型映射流程，按样本核查结果
- 多币种信用额度与权限范围配置

chunks.title: Enterprise Distribution Base
chunks.content:
# Enterprise Distribution Base (b2b-distribution)
Built for hierarchical B2B distribution
A distribution platform with a unified API, supplier adapters and scoped agency access. Validate available supply using your credentials, markets and hotel list.

## Value proposition
One API connects supplier adapters. Hierarchical entities and scoped permissions support B2B agency workflows; validate coverage with your credentials.

## Technical highlights
- Platform, tenant, customer and customer-account entity hierarchy
- Supplier adapters behind a unified API
- Hotel and room mapping validated with samples
- Multi-currency credit and scoped permissions

chunks.title: TraceSight 追光
chunks.content:
# TraceSight 追光 (tracesight)
用会话上下文调查分销问题
TraceSight 汇集会话级请求上下文，帮助团队调查搜索、预订与供应商交互。具体可见字段与保留期限应按部署和权限验证。

## 核心价值
从一次真实请求出发，核对时间线、上游响应与权限范围内可见的证据。

## 技术亮点
- 会话标识关联请求与日志
- 供应商交互与耗时上下文
- 按角色查看可用诊断证据

chunks.title: TraceSight
chunks.content:
# TraceSight (tracesight)
Investigate distribution issues with session context
TraceSight brings together session-level request context for investigating search, booking and supplier interactions. Validate visible fields and retention in your deployment and role scope.

## Value proposition
Start from a real request and review its timeline, upstream response and evidence available within your permissions.

## Technical highlights
- Session identifiers connect requests and logs
- Supplier interaction and latency context
- Role-scoped diagnostic evidence

chunks.title: RevenuePilot 益策
chunks.content:
# RevenuePilot 益策 (revenuepilot)
像量化策略一样运营酒店分销收益
RevenuePilot 是面向酒店分销的 AI 收益策略引擎。当前链路已覆盖自然语言策略草稿、发布前模拟证据和受控保存确认，并沿着赚钱机会识别与收益 Agent 编排继续演进，帮助客户在转化率、利润率和供应稳定性之间做更快、更有证据的决策。

## 核心价值
把商业策略从“人工经验 + 静态规则”升级为“AI 生成 + 模拟证据 + 受控保存”，让客户更快验证赚钱策略，并控制误配风险。

## 技术亮点
- 收益策略意图识别与结构化草稿生成
- 支持新增策略与修改既有策略的差异化应用路径
- Simulation-before-enable：命中模拟、收益影响、证据绑定与审计上下文
- 与 HotelByte 加价、供应商条件、RBAC 和保存确认流程原生集成

## 套餐
- **RevenuePilot Strategy**: 收益策略配置与模拟 — 面向商业团队的策略配置层。支持加价、客群、市场、供应商条件等策略模板，以及命中预览和发布前模拟证据。
- **RevenuePilot Quant**: AI 策略生成与证据校验 — 用自然语言描述收益目标，AI 自动识别策略意图、补齐必要字段、生成可审核草稿，并要求通过模拟证据后才能启用保存。
- **RevenuePilot Agent**: 收益策略运营助手 — 收益 Agent 串联赚钱机会识别、策略建议、多轮澄清、模拟证据、保存确认和审计上下文；更深的治理能力通过扩展点接入。

chunks.title: RevenuePilot
chunks.content:
# RevenuePilot (revenuepilot)
Operate hotel distribution revenue like a quantitative strategy desk.
RevenuePilot is an AI revenue strategy engine for hotel distribution. The current workflow covers natural-language strategy drafts, pre-publish simulation evidence, and governed save confirmation, while continuing toward profit-opportunity detection and revenue agent orchestration.

## Value proposition
Upgrade commercial strategy from manual instinct and static rules to AI generation, simulation evidence, and governed saves so customers validate profitable strategies faster while controlling risk.

## Technical highlights
- Revenue strategy intent recognition with structured draft generation
- Separate application paths for creating new strategies and modifying existing strategies
- Simulation-before-enable: hit simulation, revenue impact, evidence binding, and audit context
- Native integration with HotelByte markup, supplier conditions, RBAC, and save-confirmation flows

## Tiers
- **RevenuePilot Strategy**: Revenue strategy configuration and simulation — A strategy configuration layer for commercial teams. Includes templates for markup, segment, market, and supplier-condition strategies, plus match previews and pre-publish simulation evidence.
- **RevenuePilot Quant**: AI strategy generation and evidence gates — Describe revenue goals in natural language. AI recognizes strategy intent, fills required fields, generates reviewable drafts, and requires simulation evidence before enabled saves.
- **RevenuePilot Agent**: Revenue strategy operations assistant — The revenue agent connects profit-opportunity detection, strategy suggestions, multi-turn clarification, simulation evidence, save confirmation, and audit context; deeper governance can plug in through extension points.

chunks.title: 私有化 AI 部署评估
chunks.content:
# 私有化 AI 部署评估 (deepseek-appliance)
在目标环境验证模型、硬件与数据治理
围绕酒店分销工作流评估私有化 AI 的模型、硬件、数据来源与访问控制。具体配置和交付条件须在目标环境中验证。

## 核心价值
以目标环境中的实测结果决定私有化 AI 方案，而非依赖未经验证的规格与效果承诺。

## 技术亮点
- 模型与目标硬件兼容性测试
- 获批业务数据的检索与权限验证
- 网络出站、日志和保留策略审查

chunks.title: Private AI Deployment Evaluation
chunks.content:
# Private AI Deployment Evaluation (deepseek-appliance)
Validate models, hardware and governance in your environment
Evaluate models, hardware, data sources and access controls for on-premises AI in hotel distribution. Validate configuration and delivery in the target environment.

## Value proposition
Choose an on-premises AI approach using measured results in the target environment.

## Technical highlights
- Model and target-hardware compatibility testing
- Retrieval and permission checks on approved business data
- Network egress, logging and retention review
